entries.name: ALPACKA
entries.summary: Desktop launcher for creative-tool projects and services, with a searchable project library, templated project creation, TD version pinning, and live process tracking.

entries.name: Acro TD Component Creator
entries.summary: Dialog-based component scaffolding for TouchDesigner, generating extensions, callbacks, parameter pages, and optional network protocol DATs.

entries.name: Acro TD Core
entries.summary: TouchDesigner project template bundling seven modules as git subtrees, with version management, external tox handling, and component scaffolding.

entries.name: Acro TD Hotkey Manager
entries.summary: Central keyboard-shortcut registry for TouchDesigner components, owning keyboard input, modifier-state tracking, and conflict resolution.

entries.name: Acro TD Macros
entries.summary: Hierarchical macro framework for TouchDesigner: named units of behaviour with on-disk persistence, callbacks, and signal routing.

entries.name: Acro TD MCP
entries.summary: MCP bridge exposing TouchDesigner scene introspection and Python execution to Claude Code or any MCP-aware client.

entries.name: Acro TD Theme Manager
entries.summary: CSS-based theming for TouchDesigner, applying palettes to ui.colors, TUIK2 component params, and op-shortcut params from a single file.

entries.name: Acro TD Version Manager
entries.summary: Central version and tox management for TouchDesigner components: external tox save/load, semantic versioning, and remote update checks.

entries.name: Acro TD Widgets
entries.summary: Widget framework for building custom in-TD UIs from a reusable library of primitives, with a container primitive and component browser.
